y-m-62-02.title: Nau’i-nau’i nawa (a, b) ne ke sa aikin ya ci gaba?
y-m-62-02.topic: Ci gaba da iya samo abin da aka samu ga ayyukan da aka bayyana bisa ɓangarori
y-m-62-02.goal: Ta amfani da misalan da ka gina da kanka, tabbatar cewa akwai nau’i-nau’i marasa iyaka, ba guda ɗaya kawai ba, na ma’aunan da ke sa aiki mai ɓangarori ya ci gaba a x=1; sannan ka tantance yadda nau’i-nau’in da za a iya samo abin da aka samu suma suka bambanta.
y-m-62-02.material: Ga tsayayyun a da b, an bayyana aikin f kamar haka (x lambar gaske ce). Idan x<1, f(x)=x murabba’i da a ninkakken x (x²+ax); idan x≥1, f(x)=2x+b. A ƙasa, a da b tsayayyun ma’aunai ne masu zaman kansu.
y-m-62-02.thinking.0: Kwatanta adadin abubuwan da ba a sani ba da adadin sharuddan
y-m-62-02.thinking.1: Gina mafita da dama, ka duba sharuddan
y-m-62-02.thinking.2: Bambanta ci gaba da iya samo abin da aka samu
y-m-62-02.prereq.1: Sharadin ci gaban aiki a x=a (iyakar hagu = iyakar dama = ƙimar aikin)
y-m-62-02.prereq.2: Nemo abin da aka samu na ayyukan polynomial (x murabba’i, furucin layi)
y-m-62-02.prereq.3: Ma’anar abin da aka samu (gangarorin hagu da dama dole su yi daidai don a iya samo shi)
y-m-62-02.s.s1.prompt: Nau’i-nau’i nawa (a,b) ne ke sa f ya ci gaba a x=1? Kafin lissafi, zaɓi hukunci mafi dacewa.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ƙimomin da ake samu idan aka saka x=1 a furucin hagu da na dama a x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙidaya lissafin a da b nawa sharadin daidaiton ƙimomin biyu ya bayar.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.a: Nau’i-nau’i guda ɗaya ne kawai, inda aka tantance a da b duka.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka saboda akwai abubuwan da ba a sani ba guda biyu dole a samu ƙimomi guda. Ƙidaya lissafin nawa ci gaban ya bayar.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.b: An tantance a da b a matsayin nau’i-nau’i biyu mabambanta.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.b: Duba inda dalilin nau’i-nau’i biyu ya fito. Dubi adadin lissafi da kuma darajarsu.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.c: Furucin ya bambanta a kowane tazara, saboda haka babu nau’i-nau’i da za su sa aikin ya ci gaba.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.r.c: Ka ɗauka cewa furuci mabambanta a kowane tazara yana nufin ba za su haɗu ba. Kwatanta ƙimomin furucin biyun kai tsaye a x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.o.d: Lissafi guda ne kawai, saboda haka zaɓin a yana tantance b.
y-m-62-02.s.s1.explain: Don ya ci gaba a x=1, iyakar hagu 1+a da ƙimar aikin (iyakar dama) 2+b dole su yi daidai. Wannan lissafi guda ɗaya ne kawai, saboda haka b=a−1; idan ka zaɓi a da kanka, an tantance b.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri nau’i-nau’i uku mabambanta (a,b) na cikakkun lambobi da ke ci gaba a x=1, tare da cikakkiyar ƙimar a ba ta wuce 4 ba.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi a guda, ka nemo ƙimar furucin hagu a x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.hint.1: Daidaita b don ya yi daidai da ƙimar furucin dama.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyakar hagu 1+a da iyakar dama (ƙimar aikin) 2+b sun yi daidai.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.fail.c1: A x=1, ƙimar furucin hagu 1+a da ta dama 2+b ba su yi daidai ba.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.ok.c3: Cikakkiyar ƙimar a ba ta wuce 4 ba.
y-m-62-02.s.s2.explain: Aikin yana ci gaba idan b=a−1. Misalai: (0, −1), (2, 1), (−3, −4). Idan a ɗaya ne, b ma ɗaya ne, saboda haka don nau’i-nau’in su bambanta, dole a su bambanta.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.prompt: Daga nau’i-nau’in da ka gina yanzu, zaɓi magana daidai game da waɗanda kuma za a iya samo abin da aka samu a x=1. (Don a iya samo shi a x=1, abubuwan da aka samu daga hagu da dama dole su yi daidai.)
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo abin da aka samu na furucin gefen x<1, sannan ka nemo ƙimarsa a x=1.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko akwai a da zai sa ya yi daidai da gangarar furucin dama.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.a: Cikin nau’i-nau’in da ke ci gaba, nau’i-nau’i a=0, b=−1 kaɗai ne za a iya samo abin da aka samu.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.b: Idan yana ci gaba, ana iya samo abin da aka samu, saboda haka duk nau’i-nau’in da ka gina sun dace.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.b: Ka ɗauka cewa ci gaba yana nufin ana iya samo abin da aka samu. Nemo gangarorin hagu da dama dabam, ka kwatanta.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.c: Babu ɗaya daga cikin nau’i-nau’in masu ci gaba da za a iya samo abin da aka samu.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.c: Ka yanke hukunci ba tare da kwatanta gangarori ba. Duba ko akwai a da zai sa gangarar hagu 2+a da ta dama 2 su yi daidai.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.o.d: Yayin da a ke ƙaruwa, aikin yana ƙara dacewa da iya samo abin da aka samu.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.r.d: Yayin da a ke ƙaruwa, gangarar hagu 2+a ma tana ƙaruwa kuma tana ƙara nisa da 2 na dama. Nemo ƙimar da gangarorin suka yi daidai.
y-m-62-02.s.s3.explain: A x=1, abin da aka samu daga hagu shi ne 2·1+a=2+a, daga dama kuma 2. Don su yi daidai, a=0; daga sharadin ci gaba kuma b=−1. Ko da yana ci gaba, nau’i-nau’i mafi yawa suna lanƙwashewa a x=1, don haka ba za a iya samo abin da aka samu ba.

y-m-62-01.title: Duba mafitar da ta nemo iyaka a x=2
y-m-62-01.topic: Bambanta iyaka daga hagu da daga dama da ƙimar aikin
y-m-62-01.goal: Ta gano kuskure a mafita, tabbatar cewa ko da an ayyana ƙimar aikin a x=2, ta bambanta da ƙimar iyaka; idan iyakokin hagu da dama sun bambanta, babu iyaka.
y-m-62-01.material: An bayyana aikin f kamar haka (x lambar gaske ce). Idan x<2, f(x)=x+1; idan x=2, f(2)=5; idan x>2, f(x)=x murabba’i a debe 1 (x²−1). Aikin g kuwa: idan x<2, g(x)=x+1; idan x=2, g(2)=3; idan x>2, g(x)=x murabba’i (x²). Wani ɗalibi ya rubuta mafitar nemo iyakar f yayin da x ke zuwa 2 kamar haka.

y-m-62-01.prereq.0: Zaton jerin makaranta: H2 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne kawai a tsarin samarwa, ba yana nufin an ware shi ga wani ajin makaranta ba. An yi shi ne ga ɗaliban da suka riga suka koyi abubuwan da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-62-01.prereq.1: Ma’anar iyakar aiki (ƙimar da f(x) ke matsowa yayin da x ke matsowa a)
y-m-62-01.prereq.2: Ma’anar alamomin iyakar hagu da dama (x yana matsowa a daga ƙasa da a ko sama da a)

y-m-62-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a mafitar ɗalibin da dalilinsa ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane layi, nuna ko ƙimar da aka yi amfani da ita daga inda x≠2 ta fito ne ko daga x=2.

y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.1: Yayin da x ke matsowa 2, x ba 2 ba ne, don haka yi amfani da f(x)=x+1 a gefen ƙasa da 2, da f(x)=x²−1 a gefen sama da 2.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.2: Zuwo 2 daga hagu: iyakar x+1 ita ce 3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.3: Zuwo 2 daga dama: iyakar x²−1 ita ce 3.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.line.4: Iyakokin hagu da dama iri ɗaya ne, don haka iyakar tana wanzuwa, ƙimarta kuma f(2)=5 ce.
y-m-62-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 5 bai daidai ba. A layuka 3 da 4, iyakokin hagu da dama duka 3 ne, don haka iyakar tana wanzuwa kuma ƙimarta 3 ce. Ƙimar iyaka tana samuwa daga ƙimomin yayin da x ke matsowa 2; ƙimar aikin f(2)=5 a x=2 ba ta shiga wannan lissafi ba. Don haka a wannan aikin ƙimar iyaka 3 da ƙimar aiki 5 sun bambanta.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.prompt: Yanzu duba aikin g. g(2)=3. Zaɓi bayani mafi dacewa game da iyakar g yayin da x ke zuwa 2.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta dabam ƙimomin da g(x) ke matsowa daga gefen x<2 da gefen x>2.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko kwatanta ko ƙimomin biyun iri ɗaya ne, sannan ka duba g(2).
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.a: Ƙimar aikin g(2)=3 ta yi daidai da iyakar hagu 3, don haka ƙimar iyaka ita ce 3.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.a: Ka yanke iyakar ne saboda ƙimar gefen hagu ɗaya ta yi daidai da ƙimar aikin. Ka bincika ƙimar da ake matsowa daga dama?
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.b: Matsakaicin iyakar hagu 3 da ta dama 4, wato 3.5, shi ne ƙimar iyaka.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.b: Lokacin da ƙimomin biyu suka bambanta, ka ɗauki matsakaicinsu a matsayin iyaka. Dole iyaka ta matsowa ƙima guda, saboda haka sake duba yanayin da hagu da dama suka matsowa ƙimomi mabambanta.

y-m-62-01.s.s2.r.c: An ɗauki iyaka da ƙimar aiki a matsayin abu guda. Ka tuna cewa ga f, iyaka 3 ce amma ƙimar aikin 5 ce.
y-m-62-01.s.s2.o.d: Iyakar hagu 3 ce, ta dama kuma 4 ce; sun bambanta, saboda haka babu iyaka a x=2.

y-m-62-01.s.s3.hint.0: Za ka iya amfani da lambobi biyun da ka yi amfani da su ga iyakokin hagu da dama na g yadda suke.

y-m-62-05.title: Layin tangent nawa za a iya zana daga wurin da ba ya kan lanƙwasa?
y-m-62-05.topic: Layin tangent da aka zana daga wurin wajen lanƙwasa
y-m-62-05.goal: Ga tangent daga wurin da ba ya kan lanƙwasa, ba a san wurin tangent ba; ɗauke shi a matsayin unknown ka kafa sharuɗɗa. Tabbatar da misalinka cewa tangent da yawa na iya samuwa.
y-m-62-05.material: Akwai lanƙwasa y=x² (x lambar gaske ce) da P(1, −3). Idan x-coordinate na wurin tangent t ne, wurin (t,t²) ne, gangararsa 2t ce, daga saka t cikin derivative 2x na y=x². Muna son nemo t da zai sa wannan tangent ya wuce P.

y-m-62-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi daidaiton da ya dace don sharadin “tangent a (t,t²) yana wuce P(1, −3).”
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.0: A cikin y−t²=2t(x−t), saka coordinates na P a matsayin x da y.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.hint.1: Duba ko hagu shi ne y−(y-coordinate na wurin tangent), dama kuma gangara×(x−x-coordinate na wurin tangent).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan ya ɗauki P a matsayin wuri a lanƙwasa, ya yi amfani da f(1)=1 a matsayin y-coordinate. P ba wurin tangent ba ne.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.b: Duba tsarin x−t yayin saka x=1,y=−3 cikin lissafin tangent y−t²=2t(x−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya saita gangarar tangent 2. Gangara tana canzawa da wurin t na tangent.
y-m-62-05.s.s1.explain: Lissafin tangent y−t²=2t(x−t) ne. Idan ya wuce P(1,−3), saka x=1,y=−3 yana ba da −3−t²=2t(1−t).
y-m-62-05.s.s2.prompt: Yi tangent biyu daban da ke wuce P, kowanne ka bayyana da x-coordinate t na wurin tangent da gangara m.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.0: A cikin lissafin c2, saka ƙimar t guda ka duba ko daidaiton ya tabbata.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.hint.1: Canza t ka kwatanta ɓangarorin biyu, ko sake tsara daidaiton a t ka warware.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.var.m: Gangara m ta wannan layin tangent
y-m-62-05.s.s2.ok.c1: Gangarar tangent ita ce derivative 2t a wurin tangent.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Gangara m ta bambanta da derivative 2t a wurin tangent.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Wannan tangent ba ya wuce P(1,−3). Duba ƙimar y idan x=1.
y-m-62-05.s.s2.explain: Sake tsara −3−t²=2t(1−t) yana ba da t²−2t−3=0, wato (t−3)(t+1)=0, don haka t=3 ko −1. Tangent biyun suna da gangara 6 a (3,9), da −2 a (−1,1). (3, 1, 1, 9)
y-m-62-05.s.s3.prompt: Kwatanta tangent a (1,1) na lanƙwasa da waɗanda aka zana daga P(1,−3). Ina wuraren tangent suke, nawa ne a kowane hali kuma me ya sa suka bambanta? Rubuta jimloli ɗaya ko biyu. (1, 1)

y-m-62-03.topic: Sharuddan amfani da Ka’idar Ƙimar Tsaka-tsaki

y-m-62-03.material: Abubuwan da aka sani game da aikin f kawai su ne f(1)=−2 da f(3)=4. Mina ta ce, “To dole akwai x tsakanin 1 da 3 inda f(x)=0.” Junho ya tambaya, “Ba mu san ko jadawalin yana ci gaba ba, za mu iya tabbatar da hakan?”

y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.a: f(1) mara kyau ne kuma f(3) mai kyau ne, don haka dole tushe ɗaya ya kasance.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.a: Ka tabbatar da hakan ne bisa canjin alama kawai. Ka yi tunanin ko akwai ayyukan da ƙimominsu ke tsallake tsakiyar.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.b: Idan alamomin f(1) da f(3) sun bambanta, ba zai yiwu tushe ya kasance ba.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.b: An ɗauki bambancin alama a matsayin hujjar cewa babu tushe. Ka hango jadawali mai ci gaba da ke sauya alama.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.c: Za a iya tabbatar da wanzuwarsa ne kawai idan f aikin ƙaruwa ne.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.r.c: An ɗauka ana buƙatar sharadin jere. Duba abin da ke faruwa idan aiki mai ci gaba amma ba na ƙaruwa ba ya sauya alama.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.o.d: Ba mu san ko yana ci gaba ba, saboda haka ba za mu iya tabbatar da komai daga wannan bayanin ba.
y-m-62-03.s.s1.explain: Ana iya amfani da Ka’idar Ƙimar Tsaka-tsaki idan f yana ci gaba a rufaffiyar tazara. Idan ba mu san yana ci gaba ba, ƙimomi na iya tsallake 0, saboda haka ba za mu ce dole akwai tushe ba. Ba sai aikin ƙaruwa ba ne.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.prompt: Ga hujjar ɗalibi guda. Zaɓi layin da ya yi iƙirarin sakamako fiye da abin da hujja ta ba da dama.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta ko layuka 3 da 4 sun ce “aƙalla guda” ne ko “guda ɗaya tak”.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zana ko zai yiwu jadawali ya ketare x-axis zuwa sama, sannan zuwa ƙasa, daga baya kuma ya koma sama.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.0: Zato: f yana ci gaba a rufaffiyar tazara [1, 3].
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.2: Ta Ka’idar Ƙimar Tsaka-tsaki, akwai aƙalla c guda a buɗaɗɗiyar tazara (1, 3) da f(c)=0.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.3: Alama ta sauya sau ɗaya, don haka jadawali ya ketare x-axis sau ɗaya kawai kuma akwai c guda tak.
y-m-62-03.s.s2.line.4: Saboda haka ma’aunin f(x)=0 yana da tushe na gaske a (1, 3).
y-m-62-03.s.s2.explain: Layi na 4 ya wuce iyaka. Da zaton ci gaba kawai, za mu iya cewa akwai aƙalla c guda da f(c)=0, amma ba za mu san cewa guda ɗaya tak ba. Misali, f(x)=(10/3)(x−1.5)(x−2)(x−2.2) yana da f(1)=−2 da f(3)=4 kuma yana ci gaba, amma yana da tushe uku: 1.5, 2, da 2.2.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.prompt: Idan ka san ƙarin bayani guda ban da cewa f yana ci gaba, za ka iya cewa “akwai x guda ɗaya tak a (1, 3) inda f(x)=0”? Rubuta tare da dalilinka.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fadi irin motsin da ya kamata jadawali ya yi don ketare x-axis sau da dama.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo abin da zai hana irin wannan motsi faruwa.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan mun san f ..., to ... saboda haka

y-m-62-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa wannan bayanin ke hana samun tushe biyu ko fiye?
y-m-62-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka yi la’akari da yiwuwar wasu ƙarin bayanai ma (misali, sanin cewa aikin quadratic ne)?
y-m-62-03.s.s3.model.0: Idan mun san f yana ƙaruwa koyaushe a (1, 3), da zarar ƙimarsa ta wuce 0 ba za ta sake zama 0 ba, saboda haka tushe guda ɗaya ne kawai.
y-m-62-03.s.s3.model.1: Idan mun san abin da aka samu f′(x) yana da kyau koyaushe a (1, 3), to f yana ƙaruwa, don haka jadawali zai ketare x-axis sau ɗaya kawai kuma akwai tushe guda tak.

y-m-62-04.prereq.0: Zaton jerin makaranta: H2 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne kawai a tsarin samarwa, ba yana nufin an ware shi ga wani ajin makaranta ba. An yi shi ne ga ɗaliban da suka riga suka koyi abubuwan da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-62-04.title: Idan iyakar gangarar da aka auna ta tsakiya tana samuwa, derivative ma yana samuwa?
y-m-62-04.goal: Da misali mai karo da ƙa’ida, nuna cewa iyakar bambancin tsakiya a x=a na iya samuwa alhali derivative bai samuwa ba, sannan ka bambanta alkiblar maganganun.
y-m-62-04.material: Da’awar Jinwoo: “Idan (f(a+h)−f(a−h))/(2h) yana da iyaka yayin h zuwa 0, to f yana da derivative a x=a.” Ana ba da bayanai mataki-mataki; kowane mataki zaɓi ra’ayinka. (2)
y-m-62-04.thinking.0: San iyakar yanke hukunci kan magana gama-gari daga misali guda
y-m-62-04.thinking.2: Bincika dabam ko alkiblar akasin haka tana aiki
y-m-62-04.s.s1.prompt: Duba bayanan sannan ka zaɓi tunaninka kan da’awar Jinwoo a kowane mataki.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, da kalma guda ka nuna ko sabon bayani yana goyon bayan da’awar, yana girgiza ta, ko ya sa ka dakata.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.hint.1: A mataki na 3, yi amfani da kibiya wajen rubuta alkiblar da’awar (“iyaka tana samuwa ⇒ derivative yana samuwa”), sannan ka rubuta akasin alkibla dabam.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ga f(x)=x² da a=1, rabon (f(1+h)−f(1−h))/(2h) yana sauƙaƙa zuwa 2. Iyakar ita ce 2, kuma f′(1) bisa ma’ana ma 2 ce. (1, 1, 2, 2, 4)
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Bayan ganin wannan bayani, me kake tunani game da da’awar Jinwoo?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ga x², ƙimomin biyu sun yi daidai. Amma misali guda ba ya warware magana gama-gari, don haka “wataƙila daidai ne amma a ƙara gwadawa” ya dace.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Misali guda ya yi aiki, saboda haka an tabbatar da da’awar ga duk ayyuka
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka tabbatar da magana gama-gari daga misali guda. A gwada wasu ayyuka domin sanin ko tana aiki ga kowane.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A wannan misali tana aiki, amma mu ƙara bincika ko haka yake ga sauran ayyuka.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Daidaiton ƙimomin bisa sa’a ya faru ne, saboda haka da’awar ta riga ta zama kuskure
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka ɗauki daidaiton ƙimomin a matsayin sa’a ba tare da dalili ba. Samun ƙima ɗaya ma bayani ne.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Da’awar tana iya zama gaskiya, amma misali guda bai isa tabbatarwa ba tukuna
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Ga f(x)=|x| da a=0, idan h≠0, rabon (f(h)−f(−h))/(2h)=(|h|−|−h|)/(2h)=0, saboda haka iyakarsa 0 ce.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da da’awar Jinwoo?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Iyakar rabon tsakiya tana samuwa kuma ita ce 0. A bincika dabam bisa ma’ana ko f′(0) yana samuwa. Wanda ya san |x| yana lanƙwasawa a 0 zai iya ɗaukar wannan a matsayin misalin karo da ƙa’ida.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Iyakar 0 tana samuwa, don haka da’awar daidai ce kuma f′(0)=0
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka ɗauki kasancewar iyakar rabon a matsayin kasancewar derivative. Ka gwada gangarorin gefe ɗaya bisa ma’ana?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Domin yanke hukunci kan da’awar, a bincika kai tsaye ko f′(0) yana samuwa bisa ma’ana
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Jadawalin |x| yana lanƙwasawa a 0, don haka na san ba shi da derivative kuma ina ɗaukar shi a matsayin misalin karo da ƙa’ida
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Iyakar ta zama 0, don haka f yana wuce x=0 a shimfiɗe
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka fassara rabon tsakiya mai ƙima 0 a matsayin jadawali marar gangara. Ka tuna siffar jadawalin |x|.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Bisa ma’ana, (f(h)−f(0))/h=|h|/h. Yana 1 idan h>0, −1 idan h<0; iyakar dama 1 ce, hagu −1 ce, don haka f′(0) ba ya samuwa.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu me kake yanke game da da’awar Jinwoo da alkiblar akasin haka (idan f yana da derivative, iyakar rabon tsakiya ita ce f′(a))?
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.after: |x| misali ne mai karo da da’awar Jinwoo. Akasin haka, idan f yana da derivative a x=a, rabon tsakiya matsakaicin rabon gangarori biyu ne, saboda haka yana kusantar f′(a). Gaskiya da kuskure sun bambanta bisa alkibla.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Da’awar daidai ce, kuma |x| banbanci ne na musamman da za a iya yin watsi da shi
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka rasa cewa misali guda mai karo da ƙa’ida yana karya da’awar game da dukkan f.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Da’awar kuskure ce. Dole ne a bincika alkiblar akasin haka dabam.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Alkiblar biyu duka kuskure ne, don haka rabon nan ba shi da alaƙa da derivative
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka ɗauka misalin karo da ƙa’ida a alkibla guda yana karya ɗayar. Lissafta dabam abin da rabon yake zama idan f yana da derivative.
y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Da’awar kuskure ce (misalin |x|). Akasin alkibla, idan f yana da derivative, rabon nan matsakaicin (f(a+h)−f(a))/h da (f(a−h)−f(a))/(−h) ne, don haka yana kusantar f′(a).
y-m-62-04.s.s1.reflect: Yaya tabbacin da’awar ka ya bambanta tsakanin misali na farko (x²) da na ƙarshe (|x|)? Ta yaya “misalin ya yi aiki” ya bambanta da “yana aiki a kowane hali”?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.prompt: Sake faɗa wa Jinwoo da’awarsa yadda ya kamata. Yi amfani da misalin karo da ƙa’ida don bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba ta aiki.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.hint.0: Za ka iya sake amfani da ayyuka da lambobin matakai 3 na bayanan da ke sama.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.hint.1: Da farko rubuta a jimla guda: “iyaka tana samuwa amma f′(0) ba ya samuwa.”
y-m-62-04.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Kasancewar iyakar nan tana samuwa ba yana nufin ...
y-m-62-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A misalinka mai karo da ƙa’ida, ka nuna duka iyakar rabon tsakiya tana samuwa da f′(a) ba ya samuwa?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta cewa alkiblar akasin haka “idan derivative yana samuwa, iyakar nan ita ce f′(a)” tana aiki?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bincika lambobin misalin karo da ƙa’ida (0, 1, −1) da kanka?
y-m-62-04.s.s2.model.0: Ba za a ce derivative yana samuwa ba don iyakar rabon tsakiya ta samuwa kawai. Idan f(x)=|x| da a=0, rabon koyaushe 0 ne, don haka iyakarsa 0 ce; amma gangarar dama 1 ce, hagu −1 ce, don haka f′(0) ba ya samuwa.
y-m-62-04.s.s2.model.1: Akasin haka, idan derivative yana samuwa, iyakar nan ita ce f′(a), amma ba akasin haka ba. Misali, absolute value yana lanƙwasawa a 0 kuma ba shi da derivative domin gangarorin hagu da dama sun bambanta, duk da cewa wannan iyaka 0 ce.

y-m-62-06.prereq.0: Zaton jerin makaranta: H2 a wannan aiki matakin wahala ne kawai a tsarin samarwa, ba yana nufin an ware shi ga wani ajin makaranta ba. An yi shi ne ga ɗaliban da suka riga suka koyi abubuwan da ake buƙata a ƙasa.
y-m-62-06.title: Shin ƙarshen gida ɗaya ne da maximum? Bincika har iyakar tazara
y-m-62-06.topic: Mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci a tazara rufaffiya
y-m-62-06.goal: Ƙirƙiri misali mai karya da’awar cewa maximum na gida shi ne maximum na tazara rufaffiya gaba ɗaya, sannan ka bayyana cewa dole ne a kwatanta iyakokin tazara a matsayin ’yan takara.
y-m-62-06.material: Yi la’akari da f(x)=x³−3x a tazara −2 ≤ x ≤ 3. x da f′(x)=3x²−3=0 su ne −1 da 1, f(−1)=2, f(1)=−2. Hajun ya ce: “Maximum na f a wannan tazara shi ne maximum na gida 2, minimum kuma minimum na gida −2.” (3)
y-m-62-06.thinking.0: Tantance ko da’awa gaskiya ce ko ƙarya
y-m-62-06.thinking.1: Nemo ƙimomin misali mai karo da ƙa’ida da kanka
y-m-62-06.thinking.2: Bayyana yadda za a guji manta ’yan takara
y-m-62-06.prereq.1: Wuraren f′(x)=0 da derivative ya samo da teburin ƙaruwa da raguwa
y-m-62-06.prereq.2: Ma’anar maximum da minimum na gida
y-m-62-06.s.s1.prompt: Yaya ya dace a tantance maganar Hajun kafin ƙarin lissafi?
y-m-62-06.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafta ƙimomi a iyakokin tazara biyun, ka kwatanta don ganin ko maximum na gida 2 ya fi f(x) ga kowane x a tazara.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko akwai x, ban da wuraren extremum na gida, da zai sa f(x) ya fi girma a tazarar.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.a: A kwatanta ƙimomi a iyakokin tazara biyun ma.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.b: Maximum na gida koyaushe maximum ne na tazara, saboda haka daidai ne
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka ɗauki maximum na gida a matsayin na dukan tazara. Yana iya zama mafi girma ne kawai kusa da wurin.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.c: Maximum ko minimum ba zai taɓa zama extremum na gida ba, saboda haka kuskure ne
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.c: Extremum na gida na iya zama maximum ko minimum. Idan ka cire su tun farko, za ka rasa ’yan takara.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.o.d: Akwai extremum na gida biyu, saboda haka ba za a iya yanke hukunci ba
y-m-62-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka ɗauka yawan wurare ya hana hukunci. Ka yi tunanin yadda za a nemo mafi girman ƙima a tazara.
y-m-62-06.s.s1.explain: Extremum na gida shi ne mafi girma ko ƙarami a zangon kusa kawai. A tazara rufaffiya, a kwatanta wuraren f′(x)=0 da iyakokin tazara biyu a matsayin ’yan takara.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.prompt: A matsayin misalin karya da’awar Hajun (maximum 2), nemo ka shigar da x daban-daban 3 a tazara −2 ≤ x ≤ 3 inda f(x)>2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nemo f(3) a iyakar dama x=3, sannan ka kwatanta da 2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.hint.1: Canza x zuwa ƙimomi sama da 2, ka nemo inda f(x) ya fi 2.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.fail.c2: A wannan x, f(x)=x³−3x bai fi 2 ba.
y-m-62-06.s.s2.explain: x³−3x−2=(x−2)(x+1)² ne, saboda haka f(x)>2 idan x>2 (a x=−1 daidai yake). A tazara 2<x≤3; a x=3, f(3)=18. Don haka maximum ba 2 ba ne.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.prompt: Domin nemo maximum da minimum na f a wannan tazara, rubuta wuraren da za a kwatanta da dalilin zaɓensu. Sannan rubuta ƙimomin ’yan takara.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ka tuna misalin s2 mai nuna inda f zai iya fi girma a −2 ≤ x ≤ 3.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta duk ’yan takara a tebur, ka jera ƙimomin f gefe da gefe.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Kwatanta ƙimomin a iyakokin tazara ... saboda ...
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta cewa ’yan takarar su ne wurare huɗu (−2, −1, 1, 3)?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka lissafta ka kwatanta ƙimomin ’yan takara −2, 2, −2, 18 da kanka?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka lura cewa minimum −2 yana faruwa a wurare biyu (x=−2 da x=1)?
y-m-62-06.s.s3.model.0: Nemo ka kwatanta ƙimomi a x=−2 da x=3 da iyakokin tazara, sannan x=−1 da 1 inda f′(x)=0. f(−2)=−2, f(−1)=2, f(1)=−2, f(3)=18; don haka maximum 18, minimum −2.
y-m-62-06.s.s3.model.1: Idan ka duba extremum na gida kawai, ƙima na iya fi girma a iyakar tazara, saboda haka bai isa ba. Kwatanta extremum na gida da iyakokin x=−2 da x=3: maximum 18 ne, minimum −2 ne. Minimum yana x=−2 da x=1.

y-m-62-07.title: Idan denominator ya kusanci 0 amma iyaka tana samuwa fa?
y-m-62-07.topic: Iyakokin gutsattsari mai denominator da ke zama 0, da ƙayyade coefficients
y-m-62-07.goal: Ta amfani da sharadin wajibi cewa idan iyakar gutsattsari mai denominator zuwa 0 tana da ƙayyadaddiyar ƙima, numerator ma zuwa 0 yake, nuna cewa idan sharudda ba su wadatar ba ma’aurata da yawa ne, amma ƙarin sharadi yana ƙayyade amsa guda.
y-m-62-07.material: Ga constants a da b, yi la’akari da iyakar (x²+ax+b)/(x−2) yayin x ke zuwa 2. Denominator x−2 yana kusantar 0. A yanzu mun san iyakar tana samuwa a matsayin lambar gaske. (2)
y-m-62-07.thinking.0: Nemo sharadin da zai sa iyaka ta wanzu
y-m-62-07.thinking.1: Gina mafita da yawa idan sharudda ba su wadatar ba
y-m-62-07.thinking.2: Bayyana yadda ƙarin sharadi yake ƙayyade mafita
y-m-62-07.prereq.1: Ma’anar iyakar aiki da lissafin ƙimar iyaka
y-m-62-07.prereq.2: Iyakoki a yanayin da za a iya factor da rage
y-m-62-07.prereq.3: Siffar mafita idan daidaito guda ne ga unknown biyu
y-m-62-07.s.s1.prompt: Idan abin da aka sani kawai shi ne iyaka tana samuwa a matsayin lambar gaske, wane bayani ya fi dacewa game da a da b?
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.0: Lura da abin da zai faru da girman gutsattsari idan numerator ya kusanci ƙima marar sifili yayin x ke zuwa 2.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta yanayin numerator yana zuwa ƙima marar sifili da yanayin da yake zuwa 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.a: Denominator yana kusantar 0, saboda haka babu iyaka ga kowane a,b
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka ɗauka denominator zuwa 0 koyaushe yana sa gutsattsari ya tashi ba iyaka. Duba ko numerator zuwa 0 ma zai ba da damar rage abubuwan da suka yi daidai.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.b: Iyaka tana samuwa ne kawai idan a da b dukansu 0 ne
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.b: Idan a=b=0, ana samun x²/(x−2), kuma iyaka ba ta samuwa. Saka ƙimomi ka duba kai tsaye.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.c: Dole ne mai ƙidaya ya zama 0 a x=2, saboda haka ana iya tantance b daga a, amma a yana da 'yanci.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.o.d: Ana tantance a da b duka a matsayin ƙima guda.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi zaton an tantance abubuwan da ba a sani ba duka. Ƙidaya adadin lissafin da sharadin samuwar iyaka yake bayarwa.
y-m-62-07.s.s1.explain: Idan mai rarrabawa yana kusantar 0 kuma iyakar tana da iyaka, dole mai ƙidaya ma ya kusanci 0. Ƙimar mai ƙidaya a x=2, 4+2a+b, dole ta zama 0, don haka b=−4−2a. Lissafi guda ɗaya ne kawai, saboda haka a yana da 'yanci.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.prompt: Yi nau'i-nau'i uku daban-daban na (a, b) waɗanda iyaka take samuwa kuma ƙimar iyakar ta fi 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi a, sannan ka daidaita b domin mai ƙidaya ya zama 0 a x=2.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.hint.1: Soke wannan kaso, sannan ka duba ko ƙimar sauran maganar a x=2 ta fi 0.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Mai ƙidaya 0 ne a x=2 (ƙimar mai ƙidaya a x=2, 4+2a+b, ita ce 0).
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Mai ƙidaya ba 0 ba ne a x=2, saboda haka iyaka ba ta samuwa. Duba ƙimar 4+2a+b.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ƙimar iyakar ba ta fi 0 ba. Duba ƙimar sauran maganar x+2+a a x=2 bayan soke kaso.
y-m-62-07.s.s2.explain: Idan b=−4−2a, to mai ƙidaya x²+ax+b=(x−2)(x+2+a), saboda haka bayan sokewa ƙimar iyaka ita ce 4+a. Domin wannan ƙimar ta fi 0, a>−4. Misalai: (1, −6) yana da iyakar 5, (0, −4) yana da iyakar 4, (3, −10) yana da iyakar 7.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.prompt: A ɗauka an ƙara bayanin cewa ƙimar iyaka ita ce 5. Rubuta abin da (a, b) ya zama, kuma bayyana dalilin da ya sa ba a tantance shi tun farko ba amma yanzu an tantance shi.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.0: A sake duba bayanin s2, yadda ƙimar a x=2 ta sauran maganar bayan sokewa take da alaƙa da ƙimar iyaka.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin adadin sharuddan da ake buƙata domin tantance abubuwan da ba a sani ba biyu.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan ƙimar iyaka ita ce 5, to ... saboda haka (a, b)=...
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta cewa ƙimar iyaka 5 tana ba da lissafin 'ƙimar a+4 bayan sokewa da saka x=2 ita ce 5'?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta dabam lissafin da sharadin farko ya bayar da lissafin da sabon sharadi ya bayar?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka duba ƙimar b=−6 daga sharadin cewa mai ƙidaya ya zama 0 a x=2?
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.0: Idan ƙimar iyaka ita ce 5, to a+4=5, don haka a=1; dole kuma mai ƙidaya ya zama 0, don haka 4+2+b=0 kuma b=−6. Da farko lissafi guda ɗaya ne, saboda haka a yana da 'yanci; yanzu akwai lissafi biyu, don haka an tantance abubuwan biyu.
y-m-62-07.s.s3.model.1: (a, b)=(1, −6). Sharadin samuwar iyaka yana bayar da lissafi guda ɗaya kawai, ƙimar iyaka ta zama 5 kuma tana bayar da wani lissafi, a+4=5; yanzu akwai sharudda biyu kuma an tantance ƙimomin guda ɗaya.
